# Headless Surface Inventory

The generated list of every symbol exported by `@openreceive/browser/headless`.
What each group is for is in the developer guide:
[Headless checkout](../guides/headless-checkout.md).
Why the surface is curated that way is in
[Checkout design](checkout-design.md#headless-surface-curation).

This inventory exists so promoting or dropping a symbol cannot silently diverge
from the docs: the validate gate runs
`node tools/docs/generate-headless-surface.mjs --check` and fails when the list
is stale.

## On the main entry instead

`@openreceive/browser` and `@openreceive/browser/headless` are disjoint by
design — neither re-exports the other, and `index.ts` reaches `./internal/**`
directly rather than routing through `headless.ts`. That keeps it visible which
of the two surfaces a name belongs to, but it also means the inventory above
proves completeness in one direction only. This is the other one: what the main
entry exports and `/headless` does not, generated from the same export lists so
it cannot drift.
